## Design

### 2026-10-13 – So first I started with the brainstorming, how am I going to design around these constraints: Antenna, power, SD card, and ventilation and cooling.

**3h**

So first I started with the brainstorming, how am I going to design around these constraints: Antenna, power, SD card, and ventilation and cooling.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/9597cf51669b779e862081fa6d9c4c3fe9ba638a6eacda455c1d6c58748661e2.png)

So, in the image below is my V1 design that only accounts for the antenna that will communicate with my computer and send telemetry back and forth. This also means that if the SD were to fail, the data would be received to my computer, hopefully!

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-13 at 10.49.43 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/842a45f340d3f8eb81b76aede9d56902ffde0779315fd40db71b9d7fd4595b36.jpg)

The next image is my V2 design in where it also uses the idea that the screw terminal block will pop out and to account for that I made sure to cut and opening for it

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-13 at 10.57.40 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/0c12faf131607917b12cff5f4458fb3300262a8b0e7ee8e7f3c30417700775f1.jpg)

### 2026-10-16 – Still doing PCB brainstorming. I have created a v3 design then I have moved to a final version that should be perfect and should fit in nicely.

**4h**

Still doing PCB brainstorming. I have created a v3 design then I have moved to a final version that should be perfect and should fit in nicely.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-10-16 at 10.18.21 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/2bdd590f1b45ae9f31e3eb0f4f882324ae5af24742377c8863a478b1730cb0fa.jpg)

The image above shows a v3 design that has vents on 4 sides to hopefully make sure that it doesn't overheat, and now I have also created an SD card slot hole so that it doesn't need me to remove the whole board then to put and SD card in. There is also mounting holes so that board isn't just sitting there.

![WhatsAppP Image 2026-10-16 at 10.18.21 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/d40a0f830a6761d0dfdd3dbb2047c7ca6f13e75b21f6a067efe60b8c3a615412.jpg)

The final design will have a small fan for cooling since it'll be enclosed and could overheat, the fan will be extremely useful.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/d69d83f0b6f3bf63111c380a40610e3f9f2df8019163c2071500d42d8a2745d7.png)

I decided to use onshape rather than fusion, since its simpler, and tinkercad since onshape has more tools to use.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/b949355fb62ee1801e9e3506ab6a5660c76a9ef6ded6fd1f37f0a70b4ecbd4ae.png)

Watched a youtube video and got the bascic of onshape and will begin locking in now!

### 2026-10-17 – So first I started to work on the box, and I chose a design where the lid slides in rather than it being printer on, the reason is because when i put the lid on then i can screw the board to it, so I

**6h**

So first I started to work on the box, and I chose a design where the lid slides in rather than it being printer on, the reason is because when i put the lid on then i can screw the board to it, so I have to slide the lid out and then screw them, then close it.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 092941](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/57fca86eb0e1cb7e9dec8c72d36eb065be9c9a9f508cac03529958e7cf8f9ff0.png)

Then I had to add these groves for the plate to slide in and out smoothly, I did this by watching a YouTube video since I only knew how to extrude and sketch. Then I added the groves for the lid to slide in and out.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 093535](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/18da8ccf69b73c0fea33a10fac9470f980c38fe4f2c4df973f38e2177e1cd958.png)

Then I started to play around with the tool on on shape, and I found the fillet tool, this tool creates like a rounded edge, and I thought this would be nice to put on the top of the grove to make sure there are tolerances for this.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 094608](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/b02983c65b27c765b5afd301980d8cfbd0393d8934b191b30685db72aafb402d.png)

Then I started to work on the Lid, this was the part that would slide in and out cleanly and without me having to sand it down and all, so I gave it a 0.25 mm tolerance, and we will see if this works or not!

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 094311](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/51792b7e33fe7ca76efb75b297165b8c57b1c753c1d9d91f5a5e48205214eebc.png)

Then I remembered that I need to add a slot for the terminal block, so that it will stick out rather than me needing to raise the whole to accommodate one component, and so I just cut it out.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/4b8ef4ef0b983d66827fc969544c986dbe7802f3455fe6ec93846d85cac5fb23.png)

Then I added the fan slot that will hold the fan and hopefully prevent it from falling through and hitting the board.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/2576f6fec1f584febe4d826a8e3d660bb0363ba8859d280bf66fb033e511411f.png)

### 2026-10-17 – I finally add the mounting holes, I think they are in the right position, if not, well I can just drill new ones when the board comes and I match them.

**3h**

I finally add the mounting holes, I think they are in the right position, if not, well I can just drill new ones when the board comes and I match them.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/2bac61cacd3f325d1fe0a0788bf71444220e8237290340363cdca25c50adee3c.png)

Now I have added the vents and the SD card slot where the SD hopefully should sit and work. If not well TRIAL AND ERROR! hopefully not I don't want to keep wasting filament.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/59580f89ebb76c27b8c91624429547c39ed0c1531c5108accd0b27380c235607.png)

SO here is my finally week two assembly and project DONE!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/4c6f12f6750f2186df2681eef1820b0e77201bac707b3019d11b02a0e79d949c.png)

I learned a lot from this project, including how to do assemblies, how to create slots and groves, how fillets work, I also found out about the chamfer tool, but I didn't really use it for my project. I hope you like it! :)
